Celestial dragon-folk, lords of the agathions. Human- shaped body but with a dragon's head, scales, and clawed hands.

AC 14, HP 57, ATK 2 talon +8 (2d6) or 2 spell +8, MV near (fly), S +4, D +0, C +3, I +3, W +3, Ch +3, AL L, LV 12

Anoint (WIS Spell). DC 14. Close. One weapon or armor becomes a magic +3 version for 10 rounds.

Divine Aura. Immune to hostile spells of 2nd tier or lower.

Healing Touch (WIS Spell). DC 15. Heal one creature within close for 5d6 HP.

Holy Fire (WIS Spell). DC 14. One creature within far takes 2d6 damage.

Rebuke (WIS Spell). DC 13. Focus. Chaotic creatures cannot attack draconal or come within near range for duration.
